lane: MINEXP - lane 25 - minimum decisive Hall-only / RF+Hall / ECR+Hall experiment
not_frozen: Nothing in this file is pre-registered or approved. Every threshold is PROPOSED for the owner. No score-bearing measurement may be taken before both locks of the pre-registration (section 'preregistration': LOCK-1 before S1, LOCK-2 after S1) are completed, approved by the owner and hash-locked.

scope.question: At a common feed state and a common DC bus boundary, does adding an RF or an ECR pre-ionizer in front of the same Hall accelerator raise thrust per bus watt (or enable sustained operation) relative to Hall-only, at the operating points that bound the feed envelope?
scope.when_to_run: Only if the literature/model evidence (docs/evidence/rf_source/, docs/evidence/ecr_source/, docs/evidence/hall_sustainment/) remains insufficient to settle the ambiguity. This draft does not judge that sufficiency.
scope.what_it_is_not: Not a performance prediction, not a winner declaration, not a Hall transport validation. It produces measured, paired, common-boundary evidence on the tested hardware and a per-arm, per-point classification for the owner.
scope.rfp_context: RFP DTDF/06/13516 envelope (CLAUDE.md): 180-230 km, 12-25 mN, < 1.5 kW, < 40 kg, 26,000 h mission, > 15,000 h firing, Hall preferred, air + Xe.

rules_compliance: No Hall transport closure, screening candidate (sgb-screen-*) or withdrawn 0-D Hall result is used as a performance source; the break-even is evaluated only from paired measurements.
P5 calibration nuisance (p5_registration, p5_coil_shape, beam_efficiency_reading, facility_ingestion_interpretation) is never an axis, factor or design variable here.

Hall-closure uncertainty never leaks upstream: the feed state is an input fixed by the upstream ICD (IF-A5) and is identical for all arms; compressor and other upstream loads enter the bus sum as explicit ledger inputs identical across arms.

Every numeric value carries a source and an evidence class, or is 'TBD - requires ...'. Thresholds not in the RFP are PROPOSED. Missing or inconsistent inputs raise in the derivation script (no defaults).

Eliminations happen only through explicit rules: the hard gate G-SRC on a measured source-sustainment failure, and the PROPOSED stop rule D3 on measured paired Hall-on data over the arm's tested set (conditions not run are NOT_TESTED, never evidence against the arm). No rule stops an arm on literature or model evidence alone.
Other lanes' artefacts are referenced by repository path only and are not required by this draft or its test.

A.delivers: Per-arm, per-point classes (SOURCE_BETTER / EQUIVALENT / SOURCE_WORSE / ENABLES / UNRESOLVED / FACILITY_CONDITIONAL) measured on common hardware and a common bus boundary, plus the conditions under which they hold; enough for an owner statement of the form 'architecture X is baseline provided conditions A/B/C are demonstrated'. Does not require Physics Baseline 1.0.
A.to_reach: S0 (LOCK-1), S1 with D0 passed (LOCK-2), and S2-S4 complete for hall_only and every non-stopped source arm; S5 for the facility qualifier; S6 re-installation check.

B.delivers: Transport-independent source boundary data (P_src,bus, I_src, I_del, eta_ts, delivered-ion energy and species) and Vyovrinda-hardware Hall data (B(z) maps, geometry, coil currents, I_d traces, species fractions, divergence) that an admitted Hall closure would need to turn tested points into design envelopes.
B.still_needed: An admitted Hall transport closure (credible set currently empty: CLAUDE.md gate 3), O/O2 chemistry for air (CLAUDE.md next work 4; the air surrogate here has no atomic O), and, if the physics track wants these data as promotion evidence, its own pre-registration before the measurement.

C.delivers: Measured bus-power ledger entries per consumer at the tested points and source waste-heat inputs.
C.still_needed: Mass, thermal, life (docs/evidence/wall_life/, abep_sim/thermal_life.py), startup, cathode (docs/evidence/cathode/) and mission closure integrated; flight-representative PPU and generator; not supported by this experiment alone.

bus_power_boundary.module: abep_sim/arch_boundary.py (other lane; referenced by path, not imported)
bus_power_boundary.api_note: The shared lane contract writes the call as ledger(arch, loads, efficiencies); the power-boundary lane implements it as abep_sim.arch_boundary.bus_power_ledger(arch, loads, efficiencies) (read-only at that lane's commit a2a1396; not in this worktree). It takes, per component, the delivered load-side power at the component's load plane and the bus-to-load efficiency, and returns P_bus_W = sum(P_load / efficiency).
bus_power_boundary.basis: Every component on the same basis: load-side power at the contract load plane (COMPONENT_DEFINITIONS of abep_sim/arch_boundary.py), measured where the lab has the consumer, otherwise an explicit ledger input; converted to bus power with the pre-registered ledger efficiency of that component. Common components use identical efficiency values in every arm. No lab converter's own efficiency enters the decisive R_arch.

break_even.inequality: R_arch > 1  <=>  dT * P_bus,0 > T_0 * (dP_d,load/eta_d + P_src,bus + dP_other)  <=>  C_del < C_star = y*(P_bus,0/T_0) - kappa*V_d/eta_d - dP_other/I_del
break_even.derivation: P_bus,X = P_bus,0 + V_d*dI_d/eta_d + P_src,bus + dP_other on the bus_power_boundary_v1 ledger basis (every component: load-plane power / ledger efficiency); divide the inequality T_X/P_bus,X > T_0/P_bus,0 by I_del. Identity, no physical assumption; verified numerically by the test with synthetic vectors.
break_even.screen_bound: C_star_ub = y_max * (P_bus,0/T_0) assumes y <= y_max, kappa >= 0 and dP_other >= 0.
break_even.why_screen_only: y can exceed y_max if delivered plasma seeds extra Hall ionization or if Hall-on transport exceeds cold transport; kappa can be negative: the ID-Hall abstract (Martin Ortega et al. 2020, REF-MARTINORTEGA2020) reports that the I-V overshoot of single-stage operation disappears in double-stage operation at intermediate voltages, which the authors read as decreased anomalous electron transport. A Hall-off bound can therefore only prioritise, never stop, an arm. (The ID-Hall concept and its inductive ionization source are described in REF-DUBOIS2018; context only.)
break_even.prior_to_be_tested: CLAUDE.md lists 'RF/helicon pre-ionisers add nothing' as probably robust at mechanism level (independent of the Hall closure); it comes from the project's own models, so it is model-derived and is superseded by hardware measurement within the tested domain (docs/EVIDENCE.md). The helicon-Hall precedent (REF-SHABSHELOWITZ2014, abstract only) reports thrust marginally up and thrust-to-power down with RF power.
break_even.breakeven_efficiency: P_src,bus = P_src,load/eta_src + P_mag,bus, so R_arch > 1 <=> eta_src > eta_src_be = P_src,load / (C_star I_del - P_mag,bus) when the denominator is positive (identity; tested). Reported at every compared condition as a milestone-A condition on the flight source chain.
break_even.units_note: C_del and C_star are in W/A = V, i.e. eV per elementary charge delivered; per ion only for singly charged ions (doubly charged N ions are in the project's N2/N reaction set, CLAUDE.md next work 2).

variance_groups.cancels: no; removed by OPTION-DIVERTER (share re-allocated at LOCK-1)

uncertainty.interval: For each compared condition: ln R_hat = mean_b ln(T/P_bus)_X,b - mean_b ln(T/P_bus)_0,b; sigma_hat^2 = s_X^2/n + s_0^2/n + (f_src u_src)^2 + sum_c (w_c u_c)^2 + 2 u_inst^2 with s_X, s_0 the per-condition block SDs (n - 1 dof each), u_inst from S1b (K - 1 dof), Type B terms nu = inf; nu_eff from the Welch-Satterthwaite formula (REF-GUM2008 Eq. G.2b); h = k sigma_hat with k the two-sided Bonferroni Student-t quantile at nu_eff for the family's m. Simultaneous coverage is approximately 1 - T-ALPHA-FW (Welch-Satterthwaite is an approximation, REF-GUM2008 G.4.1) and conditional on the Type B components being correctly stated.
uncertainty.requirement_logic: Size classes against the band (-delta, +delta) with simultaneous half-width h are mutually exclusive, and UNRESOLVED is impossible iff h < delta/2 (if a point is not EQUIVALENT then |x| + h >= delta, so |x| >= delta - h > h and the interval excludes 0). Planning requirement: sigma(ln R) < delta/(2 k_plan(n)), k_plan evaluated at the planning nu_eff with every group at its T-BUDGET-SHARES share (the smallest nu_eff consistent with the budget, hence conservative). The realised h can still exceed delta/2 when a realised estimate exceeds its plan; such points are UNRESOLVED, a legitimate outcome. Non-averaging groups (G3-G5) set a floor delta_floor = 2 k(n -> inf) s_nonavg that no number of blocks can beat.
uncertainty.iso_power_model: ln R_iso = ln T_X - ln T0_iso with T0_iso on the hall_only chord (lambda = (P_X - P_nom)/(P_hi - P_nom), eps = chord slope * P_X / T0_iso). First order: var = u_T^2/n [1 + a_T^2 + b_T^2] + eps^2 u_P^2/n [1 + a_P^2 + b_P^2] + eps^2[(f_src u_src)^2 + sum (w_c u_c)^2] + 2 u_inst^2 + u_interp^2 with a_T = (1-lambda) T_nom/T0, b_T = lambda T_hi/T0, a_P = (1-lambda) P_nom/P_X, b_P = lambda P_hi/P_X. Since a + b = 1 with a, b >= 0, a^2 + b^2 <= 1, so var <= 2u_T^2/n + 2 eps^2 u_P^2/n + eps^2[...] + 2 u_inst^2 + u_interp^2, which is <= sigma(ln R_arch)^2 + u_interp^2 when |eps| <= 1 (eps is computed from the measured data at every point; the full first-order formula is used in scoring). u_interp is the Type B model error of the linear chord (T-ISO-INTERP); the budget leaves derived_numbers.plan_by_n[n].u_interp_max for it.
uncertainty.facility_family: S5 compares R_arch at elevated p_b (rows with family 'facility', m_facility conditions, simultaneous intervals with k_facility at each condition's nu_eff); m_facility stays at its pre-registered size even if an arm stops (conservative).
uncertainty.ledger_conditioning: Ledger inputs (component efficiencies, unmeasured loads) are conditioning inputs fixed at LOCK-1, not variance terms: the flight hardware that fixes them is not part of this experiment. T-LEDGER-SENSITIVITY qualifies each class; eta_src_be states the source-chain efficiency at which the point breaks even.
uncertainty.screen_uncertainty: S3 screen: u(ln C_del)^2 = u(P_src,bus)^2 + u(I_del)^2; u(ln C_star_ub)^2 = u_abs(P_bus,0)^2 + u_abs(T_0)^2 (absolute calibrations; scale terms do not cancel here). The screen's k is the one-sided Student-t quantile at T-ALPHA-SCREEN and the Welch-Satterthwaite nu_eff of these components (between derived_numbers.screen.k_screen_known_variance and k_screen_all_type_A). Stop candidate only if ln C_del - ln C_star_ub > k_screen * sqrt(sum) at every qualifying condition.
uncertainty.achievability: TBD - requires the S1 values (u_T, u_P, u_inst with nu_rm, u_src, u_c) and calibration certificates. No instrument accuracy is claimed in this draft. If readiness_n finds no n <= T-N-MAX, the owner decides before any score-bearing run (D0).
uncertainty.p5_lesson: The P5-N2 ingestion correction to I_d was 2.2-3.7 % (docs/EVIDENCE.md register, reconstructed from Brabston Eq. 13/14, REF-BRABSTON2025) and facility-ingestion interpretation became a calibration-nuisance dimension (hallthruster_bridge/ensemble/transport_ensemble_v0.json). That is the same order as delta, so the decisive metric uses raw paired data at measured p_b with no ingestion correction; p_b sensitivity is measured directly in S5.

thresholds.rationale: caps campaign length; beyond it the owner changes delta or instruments (D0)

thresholds.source: lane 25 proposal; method from REF-DANKANICH2017 Sec. IV.B (supplemental primary gas >= 2 m downstream, a pumping surface between injection and gauge)
thresholds.rationale: measures the sign and size of the p_b sensitivity without an ingestion model

thresholds.name: maximum base background pressure for a scoreable Hall-on reading
thresholds.value: TBD - requires an owner decision at LOCK-1 from the facility specification; checked at D0 with S1 p_b data. REF-DANKANICH2017 Sec. V guidance values are SPT-100/xenon specific and not transferable

thresholds.name: mass-flow levels in the S2 knee scan
thresholds.rationale: locates the knee to one quarter of the mdot_min-mdot_nom interval

thresholds.name: definition of mdot_knee
thresholds.rule: mdot_knee = the lowest scan level at which hall_only is SUSTAINED in both scan directions; if every level is sustained, mdot_knee = arithmetic midpoint of mdot_min and mdot_nom; if no level is sustained, mdot_knee = mdot_nom and every point is an enablement test

thresholds.name: low source power level
thresholds.rationale: P_lo = max(lowest stably sustained source power at that flow from S3, 0.5 * P_hi): two levels give the marginal yield and straddle the unknown dependence of C_del on power

thresholds.name: sustainment rule
thresholds.rule: SUSTAINED reading = the discharge runs for the whole dwell without extinction or automatic restart; oscillation amplitude is reported, not gating. Per condition over the n blocks: SUSTAINED if every block's reading is sustained, NOT_SUSTAINED if none is, SUSTAINMENT_MIXED otherwise.
thresholds.dwell: TBD - requires S1 thermal settling time

thresholds.name: thermal settling before a reading
thresholds.value: TBD - requires S1 thermal time constants (M12) and thrust-stand drift data

thresholds.name: S3 stop-candidate screen (D2)
thresholds.rule: An arm is a STOP_CANDIDATE if hall_only is SUSTAINED at every grid operating point AND at every bench condition ln C_del - ln C_star_ub > k_screen * u_combined (uncertainty.screen_uncertainty). A stop candidate runs only the confirmation subset in S4. The screen never stops an arm.

thresholds.name: arm stop (D3)
thresholds.rule: STOP the arm iff, over its tested set T (the source-on conditions it ran in S4: all of them, or the confirmation subset under D2): (a) every condition in T is stop-supporting: hall_only and the source-on condition both SUSTAINED and the simultaneous upper bound of ln R_arch < 0 (equivalently R_arch < 1, i.e. C_del > C_star with simultaneous confidence, by the break-even identity), or DISABLES, or NEITHER_SUSTAINED, or INFEASIBLE_AT_POINT; (b) at least one condition in T has that upper bound < 0 or is DISABLES; (c) no reported R_iso of the arm has its simultaneous lower bound > 0; (d) (a)-(c) also hold at the vertex of the T-LEDGER-SENSITIVITY box most favourable to the arm; (e) when T is the confirmation subset, the screen assumptions are not contradicted at any subset condition (y - k_screen*u(y) <= y_max and kappa + k_screen*u(kappa) >= 0), and the conditions not run are recorded NOT_TESTED (no evidence either way). A condition in T that is SOURCE_BETTER, UNRESOLVED, NOT_SCOREABLE_FACILITY or SUSTAINMENT_MIXED, or whose interval contains 0, blocks the stop. The rule uses the sign statement, not the size class: an EQUIVALENT condition whose upper bound is below 0 supports a stop, one whose interval contains 0 does not; stop support is monotone in precision (a smaller h never removes it from a negative estimate). Owner alternative STOP-MARGIN: upper bound < -T-DELTA instead of < 0.

thresholds.name: facility robustness qualifier (S5)
thresholds.rule: FACILITY_ROBUST if the size class and the stop support of R_arch at T-PB-ELEV-FACTOR x base p_b (facility family: m_facility comparisons, k_facility at each condition's nu_eff) equal those at base p_b (primary family); otherwise FACILITY_CONDITIONAL. No ingestion correction is applied to rescue a class.

thresholds.name: readiness gate (D0)
thresholds.rule: Evaluated at the end of S1 with S1 values only, before any score-bearing reading: (i) calibrations done (M1, M2, M3 load-plane characterisation, M9, M10); (ii) B(z) mapped for every configuration (M11); (iii) S1b re-mount series complete (K cycles), giving u_inst with nu_rm = K - 1; (iv) readiness_n(u_T, u_P from S1b; f_src and w_c at the pre-registered allocations; u_src, u_c Type B; u_inst, nu_rm; T-DELTA, T-ALPHA-FW, m_primary, T-N-MIN, T-N-MAX) returns an n: the smallest admissible n with k(n) sigma(n) < T-DELTA/2, k the Student-t quantile at the Welch-Satterthwaite nu_eff of the actual S1 components; that n is recorded at LOCK-2; (v) base p_b <= T-PB-MAX at every grid flow (S1b Hall-on p_b at the OP3 flow, cold-flow p_b at the others). Otherwise the owner decides (raise delta, improve instruments or the mount, adopt OPTION-DIVERTER, or move facility).

thresholds.name: re-installation cycles in the S1b series
thresholds.rationale: nu_rm = K - 1 = 5 degrees of freedom for the installation term; derived_numbers.k_primary_by_remount_cycles shows the effect of K = 3, 6, 11

thresholds.name: readings per S1b re-mount cycle
thresholds.rationale: gives the within-cycle repeatability (K (r - 1) = 12 dof at K = 6) used to fix n at LOCK-2; averages the within-cycle scatter in the cycle means

thresholds.name: end-of-campaign re-installation check (D6)
thresholds.rule: At S6 HW-0 is re-installed and OP2, OP3 (R09, R10) are measured in n blocks. For each point d = mean ln(T/P_bus)_S6 - mean ln(T/P_bus)_S2 with u(d)^2 = s_S2^2/n + s_S6^2/n + 2 u_inst^2 (nu_eff by REF-GUM2008 Eq. G.2b). Pass if |d| <= k u(d) at both points, k the two-sided Bonferroni Student-t quantile over 2 comparisons at T-ALPHA-FW. On failure every cross-installation class (R_arch, R_iso, S5) carries REMOUNT_CHECK_FAILED; stops taken at D3 are reported as taken under a failed check and the owner decides whether to reopen the arm. S6 data are never used to re-estimate u_inst for scoring.

thresholds.name: ledger-input qualifier
thresholds.rule: The owner pre-registers at LOCK-1 a nominal value and a lower and upper bound for every ledger input (component efficiencies; unmeasured loads compressor, housekeeping, flow_control, thermal_control). R_arch is monotone in each ledger input with the others fixed, so its extremes over the box lie at vertices; the analysis evaluates every vertex. LEDGER_ROBUST if the size class and the stop support are the same at every vertex as at the nominal; otherwise LEDGER_CONDITIONAL. eta_src_be is reported at every compared condition.

thresholds.name: chord model error u_interp of the iso-power reference
thresholds.value: TBD - requires an owner decision at LOCK-1 between (A) a pre-registered Type B bound (evidence class assumed) and (B) a V_mid reading on HW-0 at OP2 and OP3 (+2 conditions per block) from whose deviation from the V_nom-V_hi chord the bound is derived; the budget leaves derived_numbers.plan_by_n[n].u_interp_max for it

randomization.configuration_order: S1b on HW-0; then HW-0 (S2) first and HW-0 (S6) last; the order of HW-RF and HW-ECR between them is drawn by a seeded coin (seed fixed at LOCK-1).
randomization.block: One block = one visit of every operating point of the current configuration and stage. Operating-point order within a block is a seeded random permutation, re-drawn per block.
randomization.within_point_order: At each visit of an operating point in a source configuration: off, lo, hi, off in odd blocks and off, hi, lo, off in even blocks (off, hi, off where hi is the only level); the leading off reading is the installed-off condition, the trailing one brackets drift; linear drift cancels over block pairs. Bench visits follow the same rule with source-off probe zeros. Thrust zero taken at the end of each point visit (REF-POLK2017). derived_numbers.run_counts includes the bracketing readings.
randomization.seed: TBD - requires LOCK-1 (publicly drawn, recorded in the lock file)
randomization.blinding: Analysis runs only through the frozen, hash-locked script after the raw dataset is frozen and hashed (score once), mirroring the P5-N2 practice (hallthruster_bridge/prereg/p5_n2_prereg_lock_v1.json).
randomization.interim_looks: D2 and D3 are pre-registered interim looks: the frozen analysis script runs on a hashed interim dataset, the result is logged and never revised; the final scoring at S6 recomputes every class on the full frozen dataset with the same script.

related_lanes.relation: Full common-condition protocol (XPROT). Read-only from that lane's committed draft (commit 1428265; not merged, may change). Not a strict superset/subset relation; the owner reconciles. Differences: (1) boundary basis: XPROT measures every consumer at its DC input from the common bus (ids hall_ppu_input, magnet_supplies, rf_generator_input, microwave_source_input, cathode_heater, cathode_keeper, valves_flow_control, thermal_control, housekeeping; no compressor row, the lab starts at the valve outlets) and reconstructs bus power as P_out/eta_conv with a measured eta_conv where a lab supply replaces a bus-fed converter; this draft follows abep_sim/arch_boundary.py (load plane per component and ledger efficiency). Mapping: hall_discharge -> hall_ppu_input; hall_magnet and ecr_magnet -> magnet_supplies (sub-items); rf_source -> rf_generator_input; ecr_source -> microwave_source_input; flow_control -> valves_flow_control; the rest by name; compressor has no XPROT row.
